findings.summary: Previous Final blocker/major set is resolved in this product handoff. _mutate now snapshots the keyword index and the lancedb id set before running write_fn and restores both on the failure path alongside `git checkout -- .` / `git clean -fd pages/`, closing the index-vs-disk divergence flagged as major in rf-attempt_01KYQM7GA7HHC9B58Z3CN2CV6D; check_frontmatter now rejects empty `tags` and non-YYYY-MM-DD `创建日期`; and both the rename and delete inlink-rewrite loops skip pages carrying `_error`, so an unrelated mutation can no longer rewrite a quarantined page (INV-6).

KeywordIndex.save/load are now both unreachable: no code path persists or reads .katana/index/keyword.json, so the keyword side is rebuilt in memory from pages/ on every WikiStore construction. This is consistent with §2's '可全量重建' framing and removes the stale-ghost-id accumulation flagged in earlier rounds, but the two methods are dead code that could be dropped or wired up.

_load_index still drops the persisted lancedb table and re-embeds every page synchronously inside WikiStore.__init__, so startup cost and vector-index availability scale linearly with corpus size with no incremental reuse of the on-disk table. Not a spec violation: §6 requires only an injectable embedder (FakeEmbeddingClient / ErrorEmbeddingClient cover both paths without network), explicit degradation surfaced through index_health, and a --rebuild-index entry point — all present. Carried forward as an operational observation.
